comment: The maker's tooltip on the audio input is wrong: configInput is fed a table whose sixth entry reads LFO gain level while the sixth input is IN, the signal the filter processes (src/J.cpp:31-38 and 137). The line for that jack names the conflict, because Rack shows that tooltip on hover. The bypass to all-pass knob is offset by one inside the loop, so its stored -1 to 1 becomes a coefficient of 0 to 2: zero leaves each stage bypassed, one gives a high pass and two an all-pass, and the knob comes up fully clockwise at the all-pass (src/J.cpp:60 and 119-143). The order control blends between the outputs of two neighbouring stages rather than switching (lines 144-154). Neither the order nor the wet control is clamped. The panel prints FRQ, ODR, BHA, WET, LFO, LVL, then the five modulation jacks, LFO, IN and OUT.
